text:
Anna - Docs: FYI I opened a PR to clean up a bunch of error-ref stuff (429s, timeouts, context limits). It's mostly small: snippet updates, anchor fixes, and a redaction. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991 :eyes:
Mike - Eng: Which snippets exactly? I can take anything that mentions runtime headers or kernel notes.
Anna - Docs: Python + JS retry snippets, the CLI repro, and a short section where our long example triggers a 429 in CI. Also replacing a sample that printed token payloads.
Sara - SDK: I'll take the Python snippets. I'll change plain fixed retries to exponential backoff + jitter and add a note about idempotency. We should show both client-side backoff and recommended handling of Retry-After.
Eli - SRE: Please be explicit about 429 vs 503 semantics. 429 is rate advisory; 503 often signals service overload. Customers mix them up.
Anna - Docs: Good call 1E. I'll add a tiny table clarifying semantics and a sentence under "operational mitigations".
DocBot: link-checker: 2 broken anchors found -> /docs/error-ref/429.md#backoff-heuristics, /docs/sdk/snippets/python.md#retry-examples
Mike - Eng: Those look like doc path changes. I can submit a small patch to rewire anchors. Also saw a Markdown table causing lint failure, will fix formatting.
Sara - SDK: For JS sample, I'll swap the tight-loop example to a debounced streaming pattern and add header handling: `if (res.status === 429) { const ra = Number(res.headers['retry-after'] || 1); await sleep(jitter(ra)); }`. Also update to `retry: {strategy: 'exponential', maxRetries: 4}` shape.
Eli - SRE: Add a short note about Dedicated behavior: a single hot client can saturate a GPU pool. Recommend client token-based rate limits + server fallback to lower-capacity variants. I'll add an internal-runbook pointer (SRE-only comment).
Anna - Docs: I'll redact the token payload example. Please don't squash commits on merge 1E1E 11 I want separate changes preserved, and add a CHANGELOG entry.
Mike - Eng: Reviewing now. Small nit: one code fence included environment secrets in example output; I'll sanitize.
DocBot: ci-checker: markdown-lint fixed after table reformat. link-checker: re-run shows 0 broken anchors in changed files.
Anna - Docs: Ok planning to merge in ~1h unless anyone objects.
Sara - SDK: LGTM. I'll follow up with an SDK repo sample demonstrating jittered backoff with our client wrapper.
Eli - SRE: LGTM.
Mike - Eng: LGTM.
Anna - Docs: Merged. Thanks all :shipit:
